Educational accuracy: illustrate the described action without adding unsafe behavior or implying official certification. For buildings, conceptual educational illustration, no measurements or construction specifications.
Specific subject:A South Asian adult in an orange long sleeve shirt demonstrating Drop, Cover, Hold On during an earthquake, shown in a very clear side three-quarter view. Entire body low and fully beneath the top of a sturdy four-legged solid wooden table, both knees on the floor, torso bent downward. Their left forearm protects the back of the head and neck, their right hand firmly grips the nearest table leg. Clear visible contact of the grip on the leg. Small restrained vibration marks by table feet. All table legs stable and visible. No other hazards, no flying debris, no standing people. Absolutely not beside a table, no exposed head above the tabletop. One person with two arms and two legs only.
